stateOwner: one serial audio worker; PCM queue is private

invariants.bufferLease: one same-thread ReleaseBuffer for every successful nonzero GetBuffer
invariants.commit: consume PCM only after successful ReleaseBuffer
invariants.partialUnderrun: zero the tail and release the complete packet
invariants.endOfStream: request and release only the remaining media frames; wait for endpoint padding to reach zero, then stop and complete
invariants.pcmIdentity: sample rate, encoding, channel count, container bits, valid bits, block align, channel mask, and interleaving must match before a lease
invariants.generation: the control owner installs an exact strictly newer generation after any required Stop and Reset, then queue clear
invariants.discard: when audio is pending, Stop and Reset flush released engine audio while preserving the current generation identity; an already empty ready generation is a no-op
invariants.invalidation: report the current generation without inventing a replacement identity

worker.nativeOwnership: construct, call, close, and destroy the stream on one persistent device thread
worker.controlLane: a bounded set of generation and lifecycle commands has priority and interrupts the active render wait
worker.pcmLane: one bounded generation-tagged handoff; exact PCM identity and contiguous output samples
worker.terminal: end of stream becomes terminal only after queued PCM and endpoint padding drain
